title: durable integration outbox dispatcher

dispatcher_contract.idempotency: stable integration:<integration>:<event_id> key and claim-once transition
dispatcher_contract.adapter_boundary: versioned IntegrationAdapter with AbortSignal and no provider implementation
dispatcher_contract.observability: bounded admin metrics/details plus operations stuck/dead-letter signal and replay audit event
dispatcher_contract.transaction_io: adapter invocation occurs after durable claim transaction completes
dispatcher_contract.restart_recovery: stale active rows return to pending and eligible due pending rows are re-enqueued by startup and periodic recovery
dispatcher_contract.queue_trigger_safety: replay schedules its target in the same transaction; periodic recovery schedules due rows only after predecessor ordering is satisfied
dispatcher_contract.event_delivery_key: explicit envelope delivery_keys map is projected into IntegrationEvent.deliveryKey and matches adapter idempotency options

known_limits: No live external provider adapter was invoked; the adapter boundary is verified with a deterministic in-process fake adapter.
